title: grammica bracteata
intro: Grammica bracteata, commonly known as the Wild Rue, is a type of flowering plant in the Rutaceae family. The plant is known for its aromatic leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The leaves of Grammica bracteata contain bioactive constituents like limonene, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant's health benefits include relief from anxiety, stress, and digestive issues, making it a popular herbal remedy.
